text:
alyssa: Heads-up — we're seeing a burst of GPU pod evictions in us-west1 around 02:40 UTC. lots of tiny pods preempting larger jobs and the scheduler is doing weird latebind reshuffles. e.g. 3 consecutive preempts for the same job within 90s.

ben: saw it too, grafana shows eviction rate x6 baseline starting 02:35. packet loss looks okay but node-level kubelet logs show bind failures.

sofia: any new deploys to scheduler or kube this window?

alyssa: no scheduled changes in control plane. rolling canary for warm-pool patch finished yesterday. could be interaction between warm pool and prebind.

devon: past incidents like this were caused by stale prebind cache + affinity churn. can you dump scheduler events?

alyssa: pasted scheduler events snippet: ```kubectl get events -n default --field-selector reason=FailedScheduling --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -n 40``` shows repeated "preemptionCandidate stuck" then "podAffinity/antiAffinity unsatisfiable" for same pods.

infra-bot: Alert (us-west1): GPU eviction surge detected. 1h aggregate evictions: 420 (+350). Investigate scheduling churn.

mike: also seeing small increase in node pressure spikes (network transmit queue). could be NCCL/driver flapping causing host drain annotation to flicker.

sofia: if host drain annotations are flapping, scheduler might re-evaluate and reassign pods, causing preempt churn. can we check node-annotate timeline?

alyssa: grabbed node events and timeline. pattern: node annotates drain -> pod evicted -> kubelet reverts annotation due to transient driver error -> scheduler tries to place pod back -> preempt conflicts. repeat.

devon: do we have a list of affected node types? GPU flavor?

alyssa: majority on n2-standard with A100s in mixed occupancy racks. seems concentrated on racks with high NVLINK utilization.

mike: NVLINK saturation + driver retries = kubelet marking GPU as unhealthy intermittently. that maps to earlier bugs.

sofia: quick mitigation: disable latebind preemption policy or increase preemption backoff to smooth churn. any objections?

ben: +1 to backoff. Also we should pin high-priority long-running jobs to dedicated pools while we triage. cost tradeoff but reduces user impact.

ops-oncall: can we flip an autoscaling knob to add a cushion of reserved GPUs in us-west1 for next 2 hours? I'll run change if we agree.

alyssa: agreed. ops-oncall please spin up +8 reserved A100 nodes in us-west1c. I'll monitor evictions.

ops-oncall: doing +8 now. ETA ~7m.

infra-bot: Action logged: reserved-pool-scale up by ops-oncall (+8 A100) at 1711040200 UTC.

mike: while that spins up, let's gather traces: ```kubectl logs -n kube-system kubelet-<node> | grep -E "GPU.*health|nvlink|driver"``` and scheduler profile for preemption hot paths.

alyssa: collecting kubelet logs and the scheduler "preemptionQueue" profile. uploading to /tmp/adhoc-evict-usw1 for later.

devon: also run a dry-run placement with `--simulate` against current snapshot to reproduce. may reveal affinity loops.

sofia: long term: we should add a guard to avoid oscillating node drain annotation on transient driver errors. maybe a short hysteresis window in the node-health controller.

ben: agree. add to infra backlog: "node-health: hysteresis for transient gpu/driver errors". also add an evaluation of warm-pool interaction with prebind.

alyssa: once reserved nodes are up eviction rate dropped ~60% in first 10m. looks promising. still seeing a few stragglers.

ops-oncall: reserved nodes ready at 1711040600. cost impact estimate for 2h: ~+$1.6k.

mike: record note — NVLINK-heavy topology seems correlated with spikes. add a metric for nvlink tx/rx saturations to the GPU dashboard.

sofia: can someone own the follow-ups? i can pick the node-health hysteresis. devon take warm-pool/prebind reproduction?

devon: on it, will run the simulation and open a repro ticket with steps.

ben: I'll shepherd the dashboard change and cost amortization doc for dedicated pools.

alyssa: thanks all. next check-in in 2h or when devon has repro. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: monitoring. will scale down reserved pool at 1711046800 unless otherwise notified.
